items.title: Grand Theft Callout: ‘GTA 6’ fans are missing work on the game’s release day because they ‘don’t want to wait’ anymore
items.description: After waiting 13 years for this videogame, almost one-fifth of workers plan to take the day off to play ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ when it drops on Nov. 19

items.title: Reddit’s stock logs its biggest one-day drop ever. It’s not the last of the bad news, analysts say.

items.title: AMD’s stock slides after Intel earnings reveal two big issues
